messages:
laura: FYI — Medicore (HIPAA customer) booked a security call for Friday, they sent a 40‑page SQ. Key asks we need to nail before the call: RBAC scoping for tenant service accounts, audit log retention + export, KMS envelope patterns (HSM vs cloud), and vulnerability triage evidence. Can folks chime in with short answers we can paste into the questionnaire?

samir: +1. For RBAC we should recommend least-privilege service accounts scoped by tenant id and route. Typical roles: `svc.read_tokens`, `svc.generate_embeddings`, `svc.manage_models` — no wildcard org permissions. Mention short-lived creds (STS) for worker pods and ephemeral token exchange.

vijay: Audit logs: default retention is 90d in Console. We can export to customer-owned S3/GCS for longer retention & for SIEM ingest. We should include sample config and a note about redaction for PII before export. Example CLI to enable export: 

```
redwoodctl audit export enable \
  --dest s3://medicore-audit-exports \
  --kms-key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:alias/redwood-export \
  --filter "exclude=prompt_texts"
```

Include that export is encrypted with a customer-managed key and integrity hashes are computed.

maria: On KMS: we support envelope encryption for tenant artifacts. Customers can bring their own KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) or we can use Redwood-managed keys. For FIPS/HSM-bound requirements we offer an on-prem HSM connector in Private deployments — call that out. Also state key rotation policy: we rotate service envelope keys every 30d; master CMKs are rotated per customer policy if BYOK.

laura: Can someone paste a one-liner for the questionnaire about audit-proof for forensics? They want how we prove non-repudiation + chain of custody.

samir: One-liner: "Audit events are append-only, tamper-evident, and exported to customer-controlled storage with SHA256 checksums and signed manifests; access is governed by RBAC and all access attempts are logged and retained per customer policy."

maria: Add: we timestamp with NTP-synced systems and include request IDs + model versions in each event so you can reconstruct inference path.

ops-oncall: For vuln triage: we've got an open finding on dependency `fast-attn` (low->med) in model runtime. Mitigation plan: (1) roll pinned build with patched lib to canary cluster, (2) run smoke tests and traffic shadowing for 2 hrs, (3) roll to production with rollback tag. I created runbook steps and linked to the incident channel. If they ask for evidence we can provide canary logs + CVE patch diff.

sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-4312: "Medicare SQ follow-ups: RBAC/KMS/logs/vuln-evidence" assigned to @laura, due 2026-04-10. https://tracker.internal/SEC-4312

vijay: Quick note on SIEM ingest: we support syslog/HTTPS push with protobuf or JSON. Recommend JSON-over-HTTPS to customer SIEM with mTLS. Example sink config: `https://siem.medicore.com/ingest?tenant=abc` + mutual TLS cert.

laura: Great — I'll draft short answers using these bullets and post a trimmed doc for review. Can someone join a 30m prep at 3pm today? @samir @maria @vijay please. :pray:

samir: I'll be on.

maria: in

vijay: can't at 3, I can do 4. If you go at 3, ping me the draft and I'll add KMS/HSM bits.

laura: OK we'll do 3, will capture action items for you to review. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
